name: demo-selenium-typescript-for-google-search
summary: A beginner-friendly, TypeScript, real-assertion demo describing Selenium WebDriver browser automation against the live Google Search website.
description: Describes driving a real Chrome browser to https://www.google.com, checking the home page title, searching for 'testing examples' and checking the results title, then clicking the first result and checking the browser navigated away from google.com. Written and reviewed for correctness but deliberately never executed against the live site by this repo's own tooling, because Google's Terms of Service restrict automated querying of Google Search.
